title: Library
content: The VVCE library is located in M Block, 7th floor. It operates from 8:30 AM to 8 PM on weekdays and until 5:30 PM on Saturdays. It's the perfect place to study with a collection of books, journals, and other academic resources.

title: Principal Office
content: The principal's cabin is located in M Block, ground floor.

title: Main Office
content: The main administrative office is located in M Block, ground floor.

title: Training and Placement Cell
content: The Training and Placement Cell is located in M Block, 6th floor.

title: Canteens
content: There are four main food facilities on campus. The Food Court is beside A-Block. Another canteen is near the basketball court. A CCD outlet is opposite the main gate for light snacks. A food counter near the sports complex serves lunch at 1 PM and South Indian snacks and beverages at 10:30 AM.

title: Computer Science and Engineering Department
content: The Computer Science and Engineering department is located in M Block, 2nd floor.

title: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Department
content: The Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning department is located in M Block, 2nd floor.

title: Electronics and Communication Engineering Department
content: The Electronics and Communication Engineering department is located in C Block, 2nd floor.

title: Electrical and Electronics Engineering Department
content: The Electrical and Electronics Engineering department is located in C Block, 1st floor.

title: Mechanical Engineering Department
content: The Mechanical Engineering department is located in D Block.

title: Civil Engineering Department
content: The Civil Engineering department is located in B Block.

title: Saukar Chenniah Auditorium
content: The Saukar Chenniah Auditorium is the main auditorium is located at the D Block in the 3rd floor.

title: Examination Center
keywords: where is the controller of examiner office
content: The Examination Department or the office of controller of examination is located at the G block, 3rd floor.
